verdict.overall: The biggest move since Sunday is TSLA's 5% jump, but its nearest options flipped to fighting the rally (OPPOSING) with a ceiling right at 400, so confidence in chasing that strength is falling. AMD and AMAT show widening ceilings and firmer floors, a slightly steadier range setup, while PLTR, ZETA and APP remain weakest with persistently pricey options and earnings clustering over the next two weeks (PLTR, ZETA, AMD, APP, AMAT, NVDA) adding risk. SPY and QQQ stay calm and NEUTRAL, the steadiest range-trade candidates right now.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: weaker underneath the surface - price jumped from 372 to 392 (+5%) but the nearest options flipped to OPPOSING the rally, with a magnet near 372.5 well below price and a ceiling at 400 capping upside.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: little changed - price rose 2.3% to 329 and all four expiries stay NEUTRAL; the near-term floor inched up to 320 and the following week's floor rose to 325, showing slightly firmer support.
tickers.META: Since Sunday: little changed - price slipped 1.9% to 631, still NEUTRAL everywhere; ceilings were trimmed (nearest now 680 instead of 700), meaning less headroom, while floors near 585-610 held steady.
tickers.AMD: Since Sunday: stronger - price climbed 2.8% to 531, ceilings were raised further out to 600, and the 11-20 floor lifted to 500 though that week stays OPPOSING; earnings land 2026-11-03, a real catalyst risk.
tickers.MU: Since Sunday: mixed - price rose 3% to 904 and the 11-20 floor lifted to 850, but that week flipped NEUTRAL to OPPOSING and the 11-13 ceiling rose to 1030; earnings aren't until December, outside this window.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: little changed - price edged up 1.1% to 199, with OPPOSING still holding for 11-13 and 11-20; options stay pricey further out and earnings hit 2026-11-02, a near-term risk to watch.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: slightly weaker - price rose 2.4% to 216 but the 11-06 floor dropped from 200 to 185, meaning less support beneath; 11-20 stays OPPOSING; earnings fall 2026-11-17, inside this window.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: little changed - price dipped 0.8% to 33.70, with gravity scores and levels holding exactly in place (OPPOSING on three of four weeks); options stay pricey throughout, and earnings land 2026-11-03.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: slightly stronger near term - price rose 2.7% to 388 and the 10-30 ceiling jumped to 440, though the 11-06 ceiling was trimmed to 392.5; earnings arrive 2026-11-12, inside the next four weeks.
tickers.APP: No Sunday baseline. Price 261, trending down with very pricey options into November; earnings fall 2026-11-04 adding risk, with a floor near 250-260 and resistance clustering around 270-280.
tickers.SPY: Since Sunday: little changed - price rose 0.7% to 765, staying NEUTRAL with stable levels; in GBP terms (VUSA) the nearest floor is about £106, ceiling about £114, magnet about £109; options remain pricey throughout.
tickers.QQQ: Since Sunday: little changed - price rose 1.1% to 712, still NEUTRAL; the nearest floor dipped to 690 while the ceiling widened to 770, giving more room; in GBP terms (ISUS, rough since it only partly tracks Nasdaq) nearest floor about £79, ceiling about £84, magnet about £81.
